name: Themed controls
author: Brett
description: Replaces the controls and dialogs the browser draws itself with themed ones drawn from tokens (themed-controls@1, framework/spec/THEMED-CONTROLS.md): checkboxes, radio buttons, range sliders, number fields, date and time pickers, the colour picker, alert / confirm / prompt dialogs, the file drop zone, tooltips and scrollbars. One master switch and one switch per family under Settings → Plugins → Themed controls; pop-ups open as a bottom sheet on a phone. The original element stays in the page, hidden and in sync, so forms keep working; switch the plugin or a family off and the browser's own control comes back. Everything is reachable without the UI: REST /api/plugins/themed-controls, MCP themed-controls_*, the CLI `axf themed-controls` and voice.

items.title: Themed controls state
items.description: The master switch, the phone bottom sheet, each family's switch, the active families and what the open console last reported (themed controls per family, open pickers and dialogs).

items.title: Turn themed controls on
items.description: Master switch on: every family whose own switch is on is themed again.

items.title: Turn themed controls off
items.description: Master switch off: every control is the browser's own again; nothing a form holds is lost.

items.title: Turn one family on or off
items.description: One control family themed (on) or native (off).

items.title: Bottom sheet on a phone
items.description: Pickers and dialogs open as a bottom sheet on a phone-sized screen (on) or a pop-over everywhere (off).

items.title: Themed controls on screen
items.description: The themed controls on the open console's screen: ref, family, label, value and console-control address, as the console last reported them.

items.title: Set a themed control
items.description: Set one themed control in the open console like a person would (the form sees input and change): a checkbox on/off, a radio group's value, a slider or number, a date, a colour.

ref.description: the control's element id, name or label words

items.title: Open pickers and dialogs
items.description: The date, time or colour picker open in the console (control ref, kind, value, the month on show) and any open themed dialog.

items.title: Open a picker
items.description: Open the date / time / colour picker of one control in the console, like tapping its button.

ref.description: the control's element id, name or label words

items.title: Close the picker
items.description: Close the open picker without changing the value.

items.title: Pick in the open picker
items.description: Set the open picker's control to a value and close it: a date 2026-03-03, a time 14:30, a date and time 2026-03-03T14:30, a colour #3366cc.

items.title: Colour controls
items.description: The colour controls on the open console's screen with their values, the open colour picker and the recent colours. Set one with set {ref, value} (#rrggbb, a theme colour name such as accent, or a CSS colour name); open its picker with open {ref}.

items.skip: the open console's own report of its switches and live state, not a command
